name: South Holtburg Outpost
title: South Holtburg Outpost
summary: One of the old Aluvian starter outposts where new arrivals used to appear, 0.6 km south-west of Holtburg; unlike most outposts it was never attacked by Martine (acpedia: Hudriffa the Shopkeeper, a Sentry, Life Stone, LIFESTONES sign, well). In the kit it is a small clearing in a hollow (z 58) ringed by 30-40 m pines: the Life Stone with its sign, a well, a pitched-roof cottage and a two-storey stone shop, and on the rising ground to the south-west a three-storey tapered-roof Empyrean hall lit by four green ethereal lamps (top z 88.9) and a 31 m mossy spire tower with a candelabra (top z 104.8).

shots.standingOrder: Open wide over the meadows east of the outpost with the morning sun behind the lens: the Life Stone, cottages and well in the hollow and the Empyrean towers on the hill behind; drift slowly, 10 m above every crown.
shots.notes: Establishing over the forest hollow: from 95 m east and 62 m up (z 120, ~50 m above the meadow, ~11 m above the 32 m pine crowns) the lens drifts 9 deg and pushes 8 % toward the old starter outpost - Life Stone, well, the pitched-roof cottage and the shop in the clearing, the green-lit tapered-roof Empyrean hall and the 31 m spire tower on the hill behind - with the low morning sun (0.36) behind the camera lighting the east faces. The outpost is ringed by 30-40 m default-bake trees, so the camera stays high; a 44 m giant pine 57 m NE of the outpost is kept off the sight line.
